verdict_reason: New role assertions read the saved address back correctly, but the Importer-tick test's title hides the roles-question assertions that the 046-B coverage link relies on.

todos.issue: The test titled 'Save and select ... from the Consignee picker with Importer ticked saves the address holding the consignee and importer roles' (lines 240-263) also asserts the 'What else should this address be used for?' group's hint, its two options in order and that both are unticked (lines 248-251). The title names none of that, yet openspec/coverage links this test as the e2e witness for SCN-INS-ADDR-046-B (the add page asks the question and offers the other roles on its side), so a reader of the title cannot see that it proves the question.
todos.fix: Must: every assertion in the test is named by its title, and the e2e test that the coverage file links to SCN-INS-ADDR-046-B has a title that says it checks the question, hint and offered roles. One way: split lines 248-251 into their own test titled e.g. 'the INS add page reached from the Consignee picker asks what else the address should be used for, naming the Consignee and offering Importer then Place of destination, unticked', and point the 046-B coverage link at it.
